She wears a clay-red sleeveless wool vest over a pale flax linen work shirt, sleeves rolled to her forearms, a wide worn dark-brown belt, and a small muted ochre neckerchief. files.prompt_en: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a fully clothed child character portrait for a family-friendly fantasy adventure game. Teo is a ten-year-old boy traveling to meet his father. He has a round youthful face, short dark chestnut curls, dark brown eyes and an attentive, slightly shy expression. He wears a plain moss-green long-sleeved tunic over a cream-colored shirt, with a modest closed neckline and a simple brown cloth belt. His small hands rest together. Show a single centered waist-up painted character with clearly youthful proportions, head and hands fully in frame and ample empty margins. Detailed traditional game illustration, natural woven cloth, muted colors, soft warm light. Vertical canvas 1024 by 1536 pixels. The surrounding background is completely transparent alpha for compositing into the game.
files.prompt_ja: 用途：家族で楽しめるファンタジー冒険ゲームの、衣服を着た子供の人物画。テオは父に会うために旅をする10歳の少年。丸く幼い顔、濃い栗色の短い巻き毛、濃茶色の目、少し恥ずかしそうに注意深く聞く表情。襟元が控えめに閉じた生成りのシャツに、無地の苔緑色の長袖の上着、簡素な茶色の布帯を着用する。小さな両手を軽く重ねる。1人を中央に置いた腰までの彩色人物画で、子供らしい体格にし、頭と手全体を画面へ入れ、十分な余白を取る。緻密な伝統的ゲームイラスト、自然な織物、落ち着いた色、柔らかな暖色光。1024×1536の縦画面。ゲームへの合成のため、周囲の背景は完全な透明アルファにする。
